answer: Each epoch, a randomness beacon publishes challenge words, and agents must weave them into a fresh reply before a short deadline: one epoch the nonce pair might be bridge and cipher, the next opal and ember. Because the words are unpredictable until the epoch opens, template answers precomputed offline are worthless, so each identity must spend real model inference on every proof. An attacker costs scale linearly: sybil identities need genuine compute per identity per epoch, while honest agents pay once.
